description: Defines the ue_repository class, which manages all User Equipment (UE) contexts within a scheduler, including adding, removing, reconfiguring UEs, and handling cell deactivation.

classes.name: ue_repository
classes.description: Manages all UE contexts, including their addition, removal, reconfiguration, and cell association within the scheduler.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Marks the start of a new slot and updates the states of UEs.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE with the given index exists in the repository.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a UE by its index.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the repository.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the repository.

methods.name: find_by_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE based on its RNTI.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the repository.

methods.name: ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles post-configuration steps after UE configuration is applied.

methods.name: get_ues_with_pending_newtx_data
methods.description: Retrieves UEs with pending new transmission data for a specific slice and direction.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a UE by its index, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs in the repository.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the repository is empty.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of the UEs collection.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the UEs collection.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the lower bound of a UE index in the collection.

methods.name: handle_cell_deactivation
methods.description: Removes all UEs associated with a deactivated cell.
